'''Lenore''' is an [[NPC]] in {{Location|Ragunna City}}. She was the dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive. After completing {{Quest|Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm}}, she can be seen around the [[Order of the Deep]]. Later, after completing {{Quest|Flames in the Deep}}, she can be found on the outer walls of [[Septimont]] for a one-time conversation.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Lenore}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lenore:''' {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Ms.}} {{Rover}}! What a surprise to see you again so soon!
:'''Rover:''' Is this little pavilion the Minor Forbidden Archive?
:'''Lenore:''' Haha, you always have such a way with words. The Minor Forbidden Archive is underground, you won't see views like this down there. No, I'm actually at the Tidal Sanctuary to finalize my transfer.
:'''Rover:''' You're leaving the Minor Forbidden Archive?
:'''Lenore:''' Yes... well...
:'''Lenore:''' {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Ms.}} {{Rover}}, I owe you an apology for how I acted that day... I was stubborn.
:'''Lenore:''' Rinascita's civilization was planted by our ancestors, and the Order is just one of its many fruits. I shouldn't have been frightened by the ancient music; I shouldv' been delighted!
:'''Lenore:''' In that moment, I felt the spirit of my ancestors resonate within me, didn't I?
:{{DIcon}} I'm glad you've found some peace within yourself.
::'''Lenore:''' Hehe...
:{{DIcon}} Do the Tenets permit you to speak so freely?
::'''Lenore:''' Of course it's... Ahem! {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Ms.}} {{Rover}}, let's keep this conversation our little secret!
:'''Rover:''' Where are you going next?
:'''Lenore:''' Maybe I'll go find [[Phoebe]]. She hasn't visited in some time, and I wonder what she's busy with.
:'''Lenore:''' Or perhaps I should go further... to the Montelli vault, or even to [[Septimont]]? Hmm, I suppose I wouldn't need to wear my uniform...
:'''Lenore:''' {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Ms.}} {{Rover}}, do you have any suggestions?
:{{DIcon}} I say you should go wherever you like.
:{{DIcon}} I say you should meet the people you want to meet.
:'''Lenore:''' Ah, I aspire to have your confidence one day!
:'''Lenore:''' "True faith is born from the heart, and Sentinel's guidance speaks through my voice." From the bottom of my heart, I thank you for your help, {{MC|m=Mr.|f=Ms.}} {{Rover}}.
:'''Rover:''' Which chapter of the Tenets is that from?
:'''Lenore:''' Hahaha! I said that. I am quoting myself!
{{Dialogue End}}
